rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for pasta as a food or as a dish.

example.english: I like eating pasta the most.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ji3 fan2

rows.note: Use the full name when you want to specify the pasta itself rather than rely on the shorter everyday form.

example.english: How long does that packet of pasta from the supermarket need to cook?
example.traditional: 超市嗰包意大利粉要煮幾耐？
example.jyutping: ciu1 si5 go2 baau1 ji3 daai6 lei6 fan2 jiu3 zyu2 gei2 noi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for one plate or serving of pasta.

example.english: Please give me one plate of pasta.
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 ngo5 jat1 dip6 ji3 fan2
